mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK ( day_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_city, place_lat, place_lng, source_block_id, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, cost_type, start_time, end_time ) VALUES ( #{dayId}, #{googlePlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddress}, #{placeCity}, #{placeLat}, #{placeLng}, #{sourceBlockId}, #{blockType}, #{blockOrder}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{cost}, #{costType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT block_id, day_id, google_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_city, place_lat, place_lng, source_block_id, block_type, block_order, title, memo, cost, cost_type, start_time, end_time FROM TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK WHERE day_id = #{dayId} ORDER BY block_order ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ITINERARY_BLOCK SET google_place_id = #{googlePlaceId}, place_name = #{placeName}, place_address = #{placeAddress}, place_city = #{placeCity}, place_lat = #{placeLat}, place_lng = #{placeLng}, source_block_id = #{sourceBlockId}, block_type = #{blockType}, block_order = #{blockOrder}, title = #{title}, memo = #{memo}, cost = #{cost}, cost_type = #{costType}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE block_id = #{blockId} AND day_id = #{dayId}
